test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In which State/Union Territory is the Jog Waterfall located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Karnataka.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Jog or Gerosoppa waterfall was renamed Mahatma Gandhi Waterfall.
 
• It is the second-highest plunge waterfall (253 meters) in India situated in Sagara taluk, Shivamogga district in Karnataka. 
 
• The waters of River Sharavathi form this waterfall. 
 
• The highest waterfall is Kunchikal Falls in Shimoga District of Karnataka which falls from a height of 455 meters.
